ThingDef.label: Sweetie Belle
ThingDef.description: Sweetie Belle is, as her name implies, very sweet; unfortunately, the same cannot be said for her cooking. Carrying her reminds you of her culinary disasters, and makes you determined not to repeat them yourself.\n\nWhen equipped by a cook, she completely eliminates the chance of them poisoning any meals they make, but does not prevent food poisoning from other sources.
